name: cockpit
description: Cockpit Board: one side panel with the account's usage windows, this chat's context and cache (warm or cold, the cold price, Keep warm, the Handoff note and Resume), live progress with a time estimate, goals with a Create goal box, agents, a Needs you section for everything that waits on you (held risky commands, hand-offs, the wrong-folder nudge), a CHANGES zone with the changed files, See code changes, See visual changes (the screen before and after) and Ship (six steps to live), and the file tree; the crew skill (/cockpit:crew, which runs a big task with a crew of worker agents), the goal meter, the agents and cache-tax ship inside it, all in one pane; above the prompt, the agent routing suggestion (Do it here, Hand to a cheaper agent, Open in a new chat, Split across agents, Plan first, then build, and the Codex second opinion; the route the draft calls for is suggested, with the lane and why) and what the message being typed will cost.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale

activity.title: Claude activity
activity.description: Which of Claude's file activity shimmers in the tree: files read with the Read tool or Bash readers (rg, grep, find, cat) in purple, writes in orange and git actions in green

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: Icon set: auto uses Nerd Font icons when one is installed here, except in the desktop app; plain uses Unicode only

follow.title: Follow Claude
follow.description: on: the tree scrolls to what Claude reads, writes or commits. off: the view stays where you put it and only your own scrolling moves it; highlights still show.

minAnswerChars.title: Next steps: shortest answer
minAnswerChars.description: Skip the next-step suggestions after answers shorter than this many characters.

suggestSkills.title: Next steps: suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Tell the suggester which skills and slash commands this session has, so a suggestion can be one of them.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: What the Session and Week percents are worth in dollars: auto reads your Claude plan from Claude Code's account file; pick one to set it, or none to hide the figure

column.title: Right column
column.description: What the right column shows by default: date (last modified) or size (files in bytes, folders as disk usage computed in the background). The header button toggles it.
